When he said: "Abba'le, Abba'le"

Abba'le, Abba'le, Abba'le"

To see, to hear the utterances of the stories—this is the hitbodedut of Rebbe Nassan

The hitbodedut, only, only a little, a drop from the sea

The hitbodedut of Rebbe Nassan is the "Likutay Tefillos"

"If it were in my power, I would grant him all the requests, whatever he wants I would give him"

"Give me, Ribono Shel Olam, I cannot pray, I do not, not, not, not, not pray

I eat the way I eat, and what will become of me in the end?"

He practiced hitbodedut every day with such cries and with.. with such a heart; who sees?

And we do not know at all what, what is taking place in the world

Only Rabbainu HaKadosh revealed a drop from the sea, of what there is in the world

Such vitality, that we have such a Torah and we have such life {like this}, such sweetness, such life

We do not know {at all}; sleeping, eating and sleeping

Oy, what there is, just to hear the hitbodedut of Rebbe Yisroel (Kardonner), {..}

{And of.. of this one and of this one and of this one\\for.. for this, for this, for this}

Such hitbodedut, and he literally could.. as the general said:

"If it were in my power, I would give him whatever he wants, what he asked for, I would give him everything"

There is no such life in the world, such sweetness, such life does not exist in the world

Only Rabbainu HaKadosh revealed a drop from the sea, of what there is, the greatness of the Creator, blessed be He, wonders.. he said "Likutay Tefillos"

Who can estimate what he felt in each and every utterance of the "Likutay Tefillos"?

He lived such a life, a good life, such a sweet life

And the world does not know; only to sleep and to eat..
